name: ccover-t
description: CCOverT coral-cover research application with an evidence-gated model boundary

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ccovert/shared && npm run build --workspace @ccovert/api && npm run build --workspace @ccovert/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ccovert/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @ccovert/api" "npm run dev --workspace @ccovert/web" "npm run dev:model"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @ccovert/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ccovert/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @ccovert/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ccovert/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:model
